title: Cigar Factory Tour in Little Havana, Miami
blurb: Casa Habano, Nestle in the Historic Little Havana District, offers a unique Tour. Our Tour is educative and interactive, hands-on experience, that is appealing to smokers and none smokers alike who appreciate "art" and "Traditions". The tour, will teach you about Tobacco's origins, how the tobacco is cultivated, cured, fermented and aged. We transport you back to the future by narrating the history of the Florida cigar industry golden epic, which became known as the Cigar Capital of the World".
